topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: The traveler from afar, his face was long and tired as he told of the wind's cruel jest, delaying his flight and robbing him of a moment that could not be bought with coin. The sky, it seems, has its own mind, and no man can tame it. He spoke of missing an event, one of great import, and I could see the weight of it on his shoulders, heavier than the stones we farmers carry. I offered him a stool and a bit of our ale, though it's scarce this time of year. Mayhap it would give him some solace, a gentle bit of warmth in the cold. I know the fates can be harsh, but to miss such a thing... I hope his heart finds a measure of peace, as does the soil when rain finally comes.
